verdict.rationale: Rive's docs confirm automatic revision history that tracks all changes and allows non-destructive restoration of earlier file states (rive-docs-12, rive-docs-17), covering the 'restore any earlier state' part of the story. However, there is no evidence of naming/labeling milestones or of a compare/diff view between versions. Missing for 10: milestone naming/tagging, visual diff/comparison between revisions, independent confirmation of restore workflow.
